title: structured output: add CFG/regex constrained-decoding backends and tokenizer alignment fixes
author: Maya Chen
description: Add new pluggable constrained-decoding backends for structured output and fixes for tokenizer edge-cases. This PR introduces a CFG-based backend, a regex-constraint matcher with streaming-friendly DFA compilation, and an improved tokenizer-alignment layer to reduce spurious tokenization splits in multilingual inputs. Motivation: structured output users reported failures when using regex/CFG constraints with the OpenAI compatibility layer and during streaming/function-calling flows. The changes include: pluggable Backend API for constraints, CFG parser supporting recursive rules and partial-match streaming evaluation, regex->DFA precompilation to avoid backtracking in long-running streams, tokenizer alignment heuristics to map constraints to token boundaries across BPE/byte encodings, and integration with the openai-compatible response pipeline to ensure fallbacks when constraints are unsatisfiable. Also includes unit and integration tests, docs updates, and performance tuning to keep latency within SLOs. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and perf benchmarks.
